analysis.one_line_summary: Static promo ad announcing up to 37% off for Black Friday on the WavyTalk Power Wave hair crimping iron with Mac desktop-style graphics.
analysis.full_description: A square graphic promotional ad featuring the WavyTalk logo and Black Friday discount text at the top: 'UP TO 37% OFF BLACK FRIDAY DEALS'. In the center and foreground, styled as macOS browser windows and desktop folder icons, is the WavyTalk 'Power Wave Hair Crimping Iron' product graphic showing the pink heated styling barrel mechanism, alongside another window displaying a blonde model holding the pink tool next to her finished wavy hair.

scenes.visual: A clean white backdrop styled like a computer desktop featuring two overlapping browser windows. The left window displays a studio product shot of the pink WavyTalk Power Wave crimper with an inset diagram of hair being clamped inside the curved heating plates. The right window shows a blonde model with long wavy hair holding the pink crimper. Bold Black Friday sale text sits above.
